subject: Skyware POC outcomes & quick ask: 15m + 1-2 line quote

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Skyware POC outcomes & quick ask: 15m + 1-2 line quote

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for running the two-week POC with us. The team wrapped internal validation this morning and I wanted to share a concise metrics recap and a small ask if you’re comfortable. Attached is the one-page results summary (Skyware_POC_final_metrics.pdf). Highlights from production-like runs against your dev workloads:

- Average tail latency down 42% (p95 from 310ms -> 180ms) when routing to the Redwood-optimized runner.
- End-to-end throughput improved 3.4x under sustained load (consecutive requests/sec).
- Token cost reduced ~28% after enabling prefix caching + int8 quantization profile with negligible change in response quality per your eval set (BLEU-like metric stayed within 0.6 pts).
- No regressions observed on the 1k-sample smoke set; error rate stable at 0.7%.

These wins map to the operational goals you shared — lower infra spend and keeping latency within the 200–250ms SLO for the checkout flow.

Quick ask: would Skyware be willing to provide a 1–2 line quote and join a 15-minute call next week so we can capture a short testimonial bite and confirm permission to use the metrics/your logo in a brief case study? If you prefer not to record, a written blurb is totally fine.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 10/23 10:00–10:15
- Wed 10/24 15:00–15:15
- Thu 10/25 09:00–09:15

If any of those work I’ll send a calendar invite and a copy of a short reference approval (small MAA-like confirmation) for signatures.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

I’m also fine providing a short written quote if that’s faster for your deadline. Tentative one-liner (feel free to edit):

We’re OK with Redwood using the metrics above and Skyware logo in a brief case-study PDF — we just need a short approval step internally which Mark will sign.
